description: Decomposes an organisation into primary and support activities to locate where value (margin) is created or destroyed. Used to scope a diagnostic and to size value-at-stake by activity.
best_for: Scoping which activities an engagement covers and excludes
Locating cost pools and hand-off waste between activities

dimensions.name: Inbound Logistics
diagnostic_questions: Where do inputs wait, and what does the wait cost?

dimensions.name: Operations
dimensions.description: Transforming inputs into the final product or service.
diagnostic_questions: What is first-pass yield and where is rework concentrated?

dimensions.name: Outbound Logistics
dimensions.description: Collecting, storing and delivering the product to customers.
diagnostic_questions: What is on-time-in-full and what drives misses?

dimensions.name: Marketing & Sales
dimensions.description: Inducing and enabling customers to buy.
diagnostic_questions: What is cost of acquisition per segment and conversion by stage?

dimensions.name: Service
dimensions.description: Maintaining or enhancing value after the sale.
diagnostic_questions: What share of service demand is failure demand?

dimensions.name: Procurement
diagnostic_questions: What share of spend is under managed contracts?

dimensions.name: Human Resource Management
diagnostic_questions: Where is attrition or vacancy hurting a primary activity?

dimensions.name: Firm Infrastructure
dimensions.description: Support: general management, finance, legal, planning.
diagnostic_questions: Which governance steps add cycle time without reducing risk?

dimensions.name: Technology Development
dimensions.description: Support: know-how and process technology (described as AS-IS context, not solutioned).
diagnostic_questions: Which activities depend on undocumented tacit knowledge?

pitfalls: Mapping the org chart instead of activities
Sizing value by headcount rather than by margin impact
Ignoring support activities because they are 'overhead'
